summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by Ermenegildo Zegna N.V., a foreign private issuer, reporting the voting results of its annual general meeting held on June 26, 2026. The meeting approved a dividend of EUR 0.12 per share, the appointment of a CEO and a non-executive director, and an amended remuneration policy. No special situation (merger, tender, activist campaign, etc.) is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no deal terms, strategic review, or structural change.
